stackDivergence.rationale: Original SvRefBase31-bit count/no-delete1 gate, dummy copy/base assignment, AddFirstRef versus AddNextRef, live count assertions and last-release diagnostic count before virtual destruction. Original SvRef raw/copy/move constructors, clear versus destructor publication, acquire-before-release copy assignment, release-before-read move assignment, implicit raw-pointer prvalue selecting move assignment, equality/asserted access and make_ref argument forwarding are implemented. Direct JS fields represent the original logical fields; there is no allocator, GC finalizer, second count registry, type/default provider or compatibility pointer substitute. Actual PropertyMap now inherits this native base and last-release dispatches its existing subtype destructor/cache/Any cleanup. Original full ref.hxx and ref.cxx are compiled unchanged with15 complete verified original blobs, normal and ASan/UBSan:four complete traces contain33/72/34/11 initialized observations and match pure replay. Live count boundary is reached through real public increments/releases, without private mutation or post-lifetime storage reads. Native assert aborts bind to host Errors but process/ABI equivalence on invalid inputs is not claimed. LeakSanitizer is unsupported on the host and disabled; no leak-detection claim. WeakBase/frame compatibility wrappers, physical allocation/layout/thread/ABI and complete consumers are not certified. Not all existing map pointer carriers have been migrated; real TableData/TableManager/DomainMapperTableManager and full DOCX/XLSX model/export/UI remain incomplete. Broad parity/default/verification flags stay unverified.
